summary: Recent updates in the connection transport area have focused on enhancing the robustness and functionality of WebRTC, the technology behind real-time communication such as video calls. Notably, the separation of RTCIceCandidate from its JavaScript implementation improves code organization and maintainability, while type corrections in the nICEr library ensure better data handling. Additionally, new statistics like RTCCertificateStats and details on packets sent and received for candidate pairs provide users with more insights into connection quality. These changes matter because they enhance the reliability and performance of video and audio communication experiences over the web, ultimately leading to a better user experience in applications that use WebRTC. **Now, users can more effectively monitor the security and efficiency of their connections.**
